captions.story: We found living organisms trapped under four kilometers of ice. Would you drink water from an ancient subglacial lake?

story.series: What Lies Inside the Antarctic Subglacial Lakes?
story.summary: This episode explores the hidden subglacial lakes beneath the Antarctic ice sheet, focusing on Lake Vostok. It highlights how ancient trapped water harbors resilient microbial life in total darkness, raising possibilities for life on icy moons.

title: What Lies Inside the Antarctic Subglacial Lakes?
